root: ^You were lucky I found you in the forest unconscious.
^Even though you were missing an arm...
^I restored your arm with one of those monster arms.
^You can now use it in you favour.
^But I ask you to help me in return.
^Kill those monsters and I will help you find your daughter.
^You can look at the Wooden Board to see preferences.
^Use the Campfire to rest and write down your exploration to save your progress.
^And you can catch some rest and leave reality for some time in the Tent.
^Oh! and each time you prove yourself in that forest I will give you some upgrades.
^Just pass by the the table with some syringes.
